purpose: pinned memory-bandwidth ceiling for the roofline report (poot_profile::Ceiling)
device: AMD Radeon 8060S (Strix Halo, gfx1151, 128 GB LPDDR5X)
method: the performance bank's dense-decode-gemv case (M=1 f32 GEMV through the executor contract, planner-default schedule) at a shape whose weights stream far beyond the last-level cache: k=8192, n=16384, weights rotated over >=1 GiB of distinct copies; wall step plus readback; 3 warmup + 9 repeats per run, 3 runs
bank: benchmarks/performance-bank/ceilings/amdgcn-gfx1151.bank.json (cases.json with dense-decode-gemv shape {m:1,k:8192,n:16384} and weights-rotated-beyond-cache min_rotation_bytes=1073741824; the only edits)
command: POOT_BANK_DEVICE=... POOT_BANK_DRIVER=... performance_bank --bank benchmarks/performance-bank/ceilings/amdgcn-gfx1151.bank.json --case dense-decode-gemv --out <run>.json, three runs (poot-rocm-gpu example, release build at base_commit), under /tmp/poot-gpu.lock; median over all 27 step_us samples; gb_per_s = weight_bytes_per_step / median_us
